name: Tessera Industries Phantom Wire PW-1 'Tripwire'
description: A spool-deployed monofilament wire system designed for perimeter defense and anti-personnel applications. The wire is a single-molecule-thick carbon filament that is effectively invisible to the naked eye and most optical sensors. Once deployed between anchor points, the wire will sever anything that contacts it with sufficient force — limbs, cables, vehicle tires, drone rotors. Tessera packages it with a compact spool housing and magnetic anchor stakes, marketing it as a 'passive security perimeter system' despite its obvious offensive applications.
specifications: wire length: 200 meters per spool wire diameter: single-molecule carbon filament tensile strength: rated to 400 kg before deformation cutting threshold: 2 kg of lateral force anchor type: Magnetic stakes with 50 kg hold strength weight: 0.2 kg per spool assembly visibility: Undetectable by standard optical systems
story_hooks: Monofilament lines have been found strung across a major transit corridor at neck height — someone is targeting a specific vehicle or person who uses that route.
A Tessera facility breach resulted in the theft of 200 spools of PW-1 wire — enough to turn an entire district into a kill zone.
related_entities: Carrion Defense Works Autonomous Perimeter Defense Ecosystem

physical_description.visual_profile: A deceptively small cylindrical spool housed in a compact, minimalist polymer case. At first glance, it resembles a high-end tactical flashlight or sensor module — deliberately innocuous. The spool itself is a precision-engineered cylinder with barely visible wire edge glinting along its perimeter. Paired magnetic anchor stakes look like oversized thumb drives with recessed magnet caps.
physical_description.dimensions: Spool housing: 12 cm length × 4 cm diameter. Anchor stakes: 8 cm length × 2 cm diameter. Total kit fits in a palm-sized carrying case: 15 cm × 10 cm × 6 cm.
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly light and well-balanced — the 0.2 kg spool feels weightless in hand, creating a false sense of harmlessness. The stakes add negligible heft. Designed for concealable carry.
physical_description.primary_material: Spool housing: reinforced carbon-composite polymer with precision-machined edges. Anchor stakes: military-grade steel cores with embedded rare-earth magnets. Wire: single-molecule carbon filament (invisible).
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray polymer housing with subtle brushed steel accents around the spool edge. Anchor stakes have a dull industrial finish with faint magnetic field aura visible only under certain lighting. Minimal branding to avoid customs attention.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with brushed steel highlights. Accent: faint copper-oxide patina around magnet housings suggesting age or heavy use.
physical_description.grip_texture: Rubberized knurled grip band around the spool housing — provides control during deployment but remains tactile enough for bare-hand operation. Anchor stakes have smooth, slightly magnetic surfaces.
distinctive_features: Wire edge barely visible as hairline silver gleam along spool perimeter
Subtle depth-markers engraved on housing (100m, 150m, 200m) — functional, not decorative
Recessed magnet activation button concealed in stake design
Micro-etched NeoCortex Industries logo on housing (easily obscured or removed)
Faint molecular-shimmer effect visible in extreme side-lighting — the wire's edge refracts light at impossible angles
Carrying case lined with magnetic padding to prevent accidental deployment
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: NeoCortex Industries logo subtly etched near the spool base; model designation 'PW-1' stamped on case lid. Serial plate easily removable — suggests black-market modification kits exist.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine out of box, but field-worn units show micro-scratches on the housing and slight oxidation on stakes from repeated magnet cycling. The wire itself shows no visible wear — its threat level remains constant regardless of age.
